title: The based gauge BRST complex contracts to the global Coulomb slice

based_reduction.group: The additive mean-zero Sobolev gauge group G_0 acts by A mapsto A+d chi_0 and phi mapsto exp(i e chi_0 Q)phi
based_reduction.free_action: If d chi_0=0 and chi_0 has zero mean then chi_0=0, so the based action has no stabilizer
based_reduction.global_coordinate: The longitudinal coordinate chi_A=(-Delta)^(-1)div A and the Coulomb representative A_C=A+d chi_A globally split every based orbit
based_reduction.brst_doublet: With mean-zero ghost c_0 and sA=d c_0, one has s chi_A=-c_0 and s c_0=0; the longitudinal coordinate and ghost are a contractible BRST pair
based_reduction.cohomology: On the declared cylindrical algebra, positive based-ghost cohomology vanishes and degree-zero cohomology is the algebra on the Coulomb slice
based_reduction.constraint_compatibility: The Gauss coordinate and K1416 Koszul contraction are gauge equivariant, so the based BRST reduction restricts to the Gauss surface
based_reduction.closedness: K1399's Poincare lower bound makes the based gauge image closed on every admitted triangular tier
based_reduction.boundary: This removes only mean-zero gauge transformations. Constant compact U(1) transformations remain and must not be silently divided as a free group
